result.title: Playfulness as Feedback for Agentic Game Development
result.summary: Coding agents can generate runnable games from natural-language descriptions. However, a runnable game does not guarantee an excellent gameplay experience for players. In our view, a playful game should provide 1) reliable core functionality, 2) appealing visual design and assets, and 3) rich gameplay that supports exploration and progression. How agents can improve these aspects of playfulness remains underexplored. In our work, we propose Play2Evolve, a recursive game development framework with three stages: Initialization, Refinement, and Evolution. Using playfulness as feedback, agents playtest the game and diagnose issues in its functionality, visual presentation, and gameplay. Their feedback guides bug fixes and asset improvements. It also helps agents propose new gameplay and aesthetic goals for continued game evolution. To enrich game materials, we combine a video generation model with code to create appealing static and dynamic assets and integrate them into interactive gameplay. Finally, Play2Evolve achieves state-of-the-art performance among the evaluated methods, scoring 60.05 on GameCraft-Bench compared with 50.81 after Game Initialization and 52.46 for Play2Code. Human overall-quality ratings reach 3.67, compared with 2.38 and 2.43, respectively. Our code will be released at https://github.com/showlab/Play2Evolve.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 Play2Evolve，让编码智能体以「可玩性」为反馈，通过初始化、精修、演化三阶段试玩游戏、诊断功能与视觉呈现问题并迭代改进游戏，同时用视频生成模型配合代码制作素材。
AI.relevance_reason: 属于智能体式游戏开发的应用工作，虽含自评反馈驱动迭代，但反馈对象是游戏功能、美术与玩法而非内部视觉状态的使用、证据获取或停止决策，与 LVR 主线缺少可核查的具体联系。
